decision_rules.github: Execute only predefined ordered tasks; stop on research gate; no automatic strategy redesign.
decision_rules.gpt: Select and execute highest-priority READY low-risk research task when new progress or a pending unreviewed task exists; record evidence, avoid duplicate work.
decision_rules.resume: GitHub checkpoints and hash/audit logs are evidence; do not treat re-running a prior model as a new research breakthrough.
decision_rules.blocked: If evidence is insufficient, mark BLOCKED with source and next requirement, rather than fabricate results.
decision_rules.notifications: Report verified material progress, new failures, and decisions; send daily brief separately.
